metadata.description: Max OTC's personal Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: max-skills
plugins.description: Bundle — installs every Max OTC skill at once (max-persona-research, max-hook, max-marketing, max-doc, formatting-marketmaker-documents, max-ux-flow, max-compress, jake-writing, max-x, max-decisions, max-plan-itteration, max-blacklist, max-audit-loop, max-clean-computer, max-hard-audit, max-merge, max-musk, max-urgency). One install, every skill.

plugins.name: max-persona-research
plugins.description: Deep qualitative Reddit research for persona reconstruction, voice-of-customer mining, pain point extraction. Eleven sections, evidence-loaded, no summaries.

plugins.name: max-hook
plugins.description: Generate ten neurologically-engineered video ad hooks. Pattern interrupt, open loop, visual tension. Awareness-matched, platform-aware, algorithm-friendly.

plugins.name: max-marketing
plugins.description: Full e-commerce creative strategy — angle portfolio, awareness × sophistication map, villain/hero arc, EPIC distribution, hook bank, Entity ID variants, Andromeda 2026 test plan. Distilled from the 0€→1M€/mois ecom playbook (Schwartz, Hormozi, Rogers).

plugins.name: max-doc
plugins.description: Write or rewrite documentation in Max's house style — plan the learning paths per reader, Feynman Q&A, terse, no TL;DRs. From a product or codebase to a small set of pages that answer the reader's real questions.

plugins.name: formatting-marketmaker-documents
plugins.description: Format and render formal CRX market-maker documents to the CRX document standard — the Margin and Settlement Overview, Collateral Overview, margin methodologies, rules overviews, mechanism memos, MM-facing one-pagers. Locks one LaTeX-style document class: letterhead serif register, closed component inventory, page geometry, type and color tokens, figure grammar, and a conformance gate that renders HTML to PDF locally.

plugins.name: max-ux-flow
plugins.description: Design a UX flow finance-first (regulated, but modern — Fireblocks-grade) and general-capable — what the user sees first, what they click, screen by screen, what each table shows, how data is structured, mobile vs desktop, and the money/approval/KYC safety layer. A twenty-framework canon (Norman, Cooper, JTBD, Nielsen, Tufte, Shneiderman, Wroblewski, Fireblocks maker-checker) into an eleven-section flow spec.

plugins.name: max-compress
plugins.description: Hyper-compress any text for a human reader — keep every load-bearing point, incinerate the filler. Engine is Chain of Density held at its readable middle, output shaped like Fabric's digest, decisions ruled by Strunk, Grice, Minto, Shannon, and Forte. Finds the spine, cuts decoration not conclusions, answers first, verifies nothing load-bearing died. ~3x by default, obeys explicit targets. Not SPR/LLMLingua token-soup — readable prose for a person.

plugins.name: jake-writing
plugins.description: Write a formal whitepaper in Jake Schkolnick's CRX-litepaper voice — terse, third-person, present-tense, define-by-negation, run-in bold labels, no em-dash, no hype. Nine-dimension style fingerprint plus a twelve-axis replication checklist, from facts to a finished litepaper.

plugins.name: max-x
plugins.description: Data-driven X / Twitter growth system — pull what already works in a niche via twitterapi.io, reverse-engineer the WHY, recycle-with-an-angle, run the reply game, turn replies into a stock with data articles + CTA, and test 5 angles across a multi-account rig. The six algorithm laws, the creator-mining loop, and a runnable growth operating plan from account or product.

plugins.name: max-decisions
plugins.description: Batch every open decision into one clickable HTML sheet — question, zero-context explanation, 2–4 options with pros/cons, one recommendation, one verdict line per card. Max answers inside the page and presses Send.

plugins.name: max-plan-itteration
plugins.description: Verify a plan, report, or agent-produced doc by fresh adversarial verifier pairs until a full round adds nothing.

plugins.name: max-blacklist
plugins.description: Max's ban-word and anti-AI-slop blacklist — banned words, phrases, and 26 measured sentence-structure pattern rules, matched by a Python linter (never by the model). Ships ste-lint.py, ste-lint-code.py, md-structure.py, words.txt.

plugins.name: max-audit-loop
plugins.description: Full security audit of a smart-contract + zk-guest codebase, optionally benchmarked against a named auditor's public findings. Cross-maps the external standard, deep-hunts protocol surfaces, fans out specialist auditors, false-positive-gates every finding.

plugins.name: max-clean-computer
plugins.description: Free disk on a Mac safely while builds run — finds regenerable storage (caches, build targets, temp) and cleans only what is safe.

plugins.name: max-hard-audit
plugins.description: The 10-agent parallel audit loop — rounds of read-only lenses, a dedup file, verifier pairs + fixer on one consolidated table, cold closes, solutions per fix owner, decision sheets, one serial builder, incremental pushes.

plugins.name: max-merge
plugins.description: Consolidate several branches, worktrees, or clones of one repo into a single clean main — fans out subagents to hand-pick and rebase each branch, pushes serially, zero parked branches.

plugins.name: max-musk
plugins.description: Musk's five-step algorithm applied to agent orchestration — question every requirement, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate last. Target is 10x, never 10%.

plugins.name: max-urgency
plugins.description: Deadline-mode orchestration — a hard clock, ten or more subagents live at all times, the critical path starved of everything else, incremental pushes, a standby for every single point of failure.
